memo.Quick Summary / Abstract: The Board will call the meeting to order and establish a quorum by roll call.
Welcome by the School Board President, Mike Wells.
The School Board will review and discuss any requested additions, deletions, or modifications to the agenda prior to its adoption.

items.title: 4. Approval of the Agenda (Action Required) - 1 min

memo.Quick Summary / Abstract: Motion to approve the agenda as submitted or amended.

items.title: 5. Public Comment on Closed Session Items Only

memo.Rationale: Public Comment: The Board will limit comments to items on the agenda and will be accepted in person only. Speaker cards are available at the entrance and can be submitted to the secretary before the meeting begins, or you may raise your hand during the meeting to indicate your desire to speak. Speakers will be called during Public Comment Comments are limited to 3 minutes per speaker per topic, unless otherwise noted.

items.title: 6. Announcement of Closed Session Purpose - 1 min
1. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT (Government Code Section 54957) Title: Superintendent

memo.Quick Summary / Abstract: The Board will reconvene to open session.

items.title: 1. Report Out on Closed Session Item(s)

memo.Quick Summary / Abstract: The presiding officer will report any reportable action taken during closed session in accordance with Government Code § 54957.1.
memo.Rationale: Pursuant to Government Code § 54957.1, the Board is required to announce whether any reportable action was taken. If no action was taken, the presiding officer will state for the record that no reportable action occurred.
